transport_stagger.purpose: small deterministic tuple-id-derived stagger to prevent synchronized retry storms
transport_stagger.reproducibility: same tuple identity always yields the same stagger; stagger depends ONLY on tuple identity

retryable: transport (timeout, network, HTTP 5xx, HTTP 429) - V2.4 budget 6 TOTAL attempts incl. the initial request, with frozen backoff 2s/5s/15s/30s/60s + deterministic tuple-id-derived stagger
RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT_ABORT (code-less abort with verified transient provider/network transport cause in the cause chain) - V2.4 budget 6 TOTAL attempts
EMPTY_CONTENT (provider returned null/empty/whitespace content without content_filter/length finish_reason) - V2.3 policy unchanged: 5 TOTAL attempts incl. the initial request, no backoff
never_retried: UNCLASSIFIED_ABORT (code-less abort without transport evidence; fail closed)
EMPTY_CONTENT_LENGTH (finish_reason=length; fail closed; the 65536 output ceiling is the SOLE V2.4 remediation - no retry, no taxonomy broadening)
timeout_semantics: timeout counts as a transport error (retryable, V2.4 6-attempt budget)
abort_semantics_v2_2: code-less AbortError/TypeError (e.g. message 'terminated') is retried ONLY when cause-chain inspection establishes transient provider/network transport and no intentional abort signal caused it; classifier codes: RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT_ABORT | OPERATOR_ABORT | UNCLASSIFIED_ABORT
empty_content_semantics_v2_3: provider EMPTY_CONTENT (choices[0].message.content null/undefined/empty/whitespace) is retried with a total budget of 5 attempts (initial request + up to 4 retries) with byte-identical request and frozen model parameters; finish_reason=content_filter or =length with empty content is NOT the generic provider-empty case and fails closed (EMPTY_CONTENT_CONTENT_FILTER / EMPTY_CONTENT_LENGTH, non-retryable); every failed attempt persists full provider metadata (http_status, model_identity, finish_reason, content_length, reasoning_content_length, usage, provider_request_id, latency_ms, raw, raw_sha256) and records usage/cost when the provider reported usage; no attempt is ever overwritten
transport_retry_semantics_v2_4: verified transient transport/provider-infrastructure classes (TRANSPORT_ERROR, TIMEOUT, HTTP_5XX, HTTP_429, RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT_ABORT) get a bounded deterministic retry policy: max 6 TOTAL attempts; retry delays after qualifying failures 2s/5s/15s/30s/60s; deterministic tuple-id-derived stagger (0..1000ms) applied to retry timing; request bytes, model-visible prompt, model parameters and scientific tuple identity remain unchanged on retry; every attempt is preserved independently with backoff/stagger metadata; only already-authorized verified transient classes use this path - unknown-error classification is NOT broadened
exhausted_semantics: after 6 attempts for transport classes / 5 attempts for EMPTY_CONTENT / 3 attempts for parse without a valid response the sample is PROVIDER_FAILED (excluded, counted); finish_reason=length or =content_filter with empty content fails closed at the first attempt
parse_failed_semantics: PARSE_FAILED is fail-closed: counts as an error on every metric requiring a decision; never silently dropped
